name: Chain of Whispers — Hard
description: The hard tier of Chain of Whispers: a seeded ~550-word story with 20 checkable facts (names with roles, numbers with units, a date, places, odd details) is squeezed into at most 60 words and rebuilt into a ~450-word story, five times over (10 rewrites). Every step runs in a fresh context that sees only the previous output. The model rewrites its own text on purpose, so this measures self-consistent information retention under severe compression: 20 facts fit into 60 words only if the summary is dense and deliberate. A fact survives only if its keywords still appear together in one sentence. Words are counted by splitting on spaces, and anything past the limit is cut off before the next step.
hook: Twenty facts, sixty words, ten rewrites. What's left at the end?
author: Gauntlet Core
